summary: Frontend-only test of the Home Hub (My Home) at 390x844 on the Expo web preview. Tested: login, hub, home switcher, Manage Homes CRUD, Bills CRUD with pay/undo/quick-pay, Records CRUD, Items CRUD, Repairs CRUD with mark-done, the history log and the FIXA link, Calendar (grid, prev/next, day filter, quick Paid/Done, FAB), removal of Neighbours, and regression on all 5 tabs. Every flow worked end to end. No screen crashed and no red screen appeared. All QA data was cleaned up. Bugs found: (1) Repair schedule: picking Monthly keeps interval 3 from the default, so the repair saves as 'Every 3 months'. (2) The Bills tile shows the overdue count for bills plus repairs. (3) The item warranty pill reads 'Paid' / 'Due in Nd' instead of warranty wording. (4) records/new nests a <button> inside a <button>, which fires a console error and a LogBox toast that covers the Save button in dev web. (5) Delete handlers call router.back() with no canGoBack fallback, so a deep-linked detail stays open after delete. (6) In the item form, the Paid/Worth row overflows horizontally on web.

minor.issue: 'Ikeja rental' has 0 bills/items/repairs/records (review request said it is seeded). Lekki flat is seeded correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Repair default schedule is {freq:'custom', interval:3}. ScheduleChips.onChange keeps value.interval when you switch freq, so picking 'Monthly' saves {freq:'monthly', interval:3}. The repair then shows 'Every 3 months' and next_due is moved 3 months on after Done. Verified via GET /api/home/repairs/<id>. Fix: reset interval to 1 when freq !== 'custom'. Reference: src/components/home/FormBits.tsx:93, app/home/repairs/new.tsx:31

tile-bills caption uses ov.attention.overdue, which counts bills AND repairs. It shows '2 overdue' while only 1 bill is overdue (the bills-summary shows 1). Use bill-only counts. Reference: app/(tabs)/home.tsx:90

An active warranty is shown with StatusPill status='paid', so it reads 'Paid' (QA Fridge, Samsung TV). An expiring warranty reads 'Due in 20d'. Use warranty wording ('Covered' / 'Ends in Nd' / 'Expired'). Reference: app/home/items/index.tsx:76, app/home/items/[id].tsx:76

The delete handlers call router.back() with no canGoBack() fallback. When a detail screen is opened by deep link or from a notification, deleting the item leaves the user on the deleted item's screen, with the console error 'GO_BACK was not handled'. Reproduced for bill and repair. Reference: app/home/bills/[id].tsx:128, items/[id].tsx:46, records/[id].tsx:59, repairs/[id].tsx:100. The loading/missing headers have the same problem (bills/[id].tsx:137,144 etc.).

On web, the two flex:1 MoneyInputs side by side overflow: 'Worth now' runs past the right edge and the form scrolls horizontally when focused. Add minWidth:0 to the flex children. Reference: app/home/items/new.tsx:138-144

issues: When the agenda is short (e.g. a day is selected), calendar-fab covers the quick Paid/Done button of the first or only event row, and the content cannot scroll out from under it.
home-fab overlaps the Records tile badge and the Repairs tile corner at the first scroll position.
Action buttons are cut off: 'Book a FI…' and 'Mark d…'.
A stray 'Agreements' badge floats below the Delete button (looks duplicated).
The Find Home intent sheet ('What are you looking for?') stays open on top of Feeds, Market, My Home and My Amass after switching tabs on a fresh session.

Legacy friend-request notification ('wants to connect · Accept to share collections…') is still listed. Tapping it does nothing (it correctly does not navigate to /neighbours). Consider hiding legacy social/collection notifications.

react_native_issues.issue: The 'Linked bill' Pressable wraps a Chip (Pressable) and the 'Unlink' Pressable, so a <button> sits inside a <button> on web. This causes a hydration/DOM-nesting console error, and the dev LogBox toast covers the Save button. Reference: app/home/records/new.tsx:146-155
'repair-sched-custom' / 'bill-sched-custom' is used both on the Custom chip (ChipRow prefix + key 'custom') and on the custom-interval panel View. Reference: src/components/home/FormBits.tsx:93,95
Metro warns of a require cycle: src/ui/Button.tsx -> src/ui/Shimmer.tsx -> src/ui/Feedback.tsx -> src/ui/Button.tsx

action_items: HIGH: ScheduleChips: when you pick a non-custom freq, reset interval to 1 (and unit to the freq's natural unit). Otherwise repairs default to 'Every 3 months' even after the user picks Monthly/Weekly/Yearly.
MEDIUM: Hub tile-bills caption: use bill-only overdue/due_soon counts (the overview API could return attention per section).
MEDIUM: Items warranty pill: replace StatusPill 'paid'/'due_soon' with warranty-specific labels.
MEDIUM: Bills/Items/Records/Repairs detail: after delete (and on the missing/loading back buttons) use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/home/<section>').
MEDIUM: records/new.tsx: do not nest Pressables. Make the Chip itself the press target, and move Unlink outside the outer Pressable.
LOW: items/new.tsx price/value row: add minWidth:0 to the flex:1 wrappers.
LOW: Calendar/Hub FAB overlapping content; truncated repair-detail action buttons; stray badge on record detail; duplicate *-sched-custom testID; intent sheet staying over other tabs.

LOW: app/admin/neighbours.tsx:251 still builds /neighbours/posts|events|users|collections links. Those routes are removed, so admin report deep-links land on Unmatched Route. Point them to /social/post/<id> or drop them.
LOW: seed bills/items/repairs for 'Ikeja rental', or update the docs.
critical_code_review_comments: FormBits ScheduleChips onChange carries interval across freq changes. This is the root cause of the repair schedule bug and affects editing bills that have a custom interval too.
home.tsx tile captions reuse the aggregate attention counts for the Bills tile.
Detail-screen delete flows are inconsistent: the headers use the canGoBack fallback but the delete handlers do not.
No deprecated expo packages found (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch absent). Forms use KeyboardAwareScrollView (react-native-keyboard-controller).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows functional; 1 high + 4 medium logic/UX bugs)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: home 'QA Test Home', bill 'QA Water bill', record 'QA Tenancy agreement', item 'QA Fridge', repair 'QA Service generator', and (via API, for the calendar quick-action test) 'QA Cal repair' and 'QA Cal bill'. Verified none remain. Side effect: no seeded data was changed. Quick actions were only run on QA items.

rca_of_issue: Repair schedule bug: repairs/new.tsx initial schedule is {freq:'custom', interval:3, unit:'months'}. FormBits.tsx:93 onChange => {freq, interval: value.interval ?? 1, ...} keeps 3 → backend stores monthly with interval 3 → schedule_label 'Every 3 months', next due +3 months. Repro: Repairs FAB → pick trade → tap Monthly → set due → save → detail shows 'Every 3 months'.
